fusions.name: Gnaw and Scatter
fusions.desc: Bites for 6 damage, leaving the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Seething Mob
fusions.desc: A swarm boils out, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Brood Overrun
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scrap Survivor
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
